Life Leech

Version

10.94
May 31, 2016
Summer Update 2016

Status

Active
Life Leech, introduced with Updates/10.94, is a way to receive health points from your opponent during fighting. It can be done by Imbuing certain equipment with Basic Vampirism, Intricate Vampirism or Powerful Vampirism, by enhancing skills through the Wheel of Destiny, or wearing equipment that has Augments that provide life leech.

It is worth noting that Damage Preys do not affect the leech.

History

  • It was initially available via Charging (which was removed with Updates/11.40) and later also by Imbuing certain equipment.
  • It used to be called Hit Points Leech before the name was changed to Life Leech.

See also:


Critical Hits, Mana Leech, and Imbuing
